name: Agencia Comercial Spirits Ltd
summary: Agencia Comercial Spirits Ltd, together with its subsidiaries, imports, procures, distributes, and sells bottled, raw cask, and proprietary brand whisky products in Taiwan and international markets. It also offers brand marketing services. The company was incorporated in 2025 and is based in Taichung, Taiwan. Agencia Comercial Spirits Ltd is a subsidiary of Ping Shiang Business Ltd.
